newsitem.title: USA: Unilever to join units, sees $3bln in sales.
newsitem.headline: Unilever to join units, sees $3bln in sales.

text.p: Unilever said Monday that it will combine the businesses of Thomas J. Lipton and Van den Bergh Foods companies in the U.S. and that the new entity, expected to begin merging in early 1997 and be completed in 1998, will have annual sales of $3 billion.
In a release Monday, Unilever said that the decision to combine the consumer and food service businesses will allow the company to compete more effectively and provide higher value.
Unilever added that the new company will operate out of New Jersey under the name Lipton.

Unilever said that the North American Foods Group also includes Gorton's and Good Humor-Breyers Ice Cream in the U.S. and several food companies in Canada, and is one of Unilever's 14 international business units.
